source: GitHub label descriptions of microsoft/vscode, fetched 2026-10-10

labels.accessibility: Keyboard, mouse, ARIA, vision, screen readers (non-specific) issues
labels.browser-integration: Web browsing features integrated into VS Code (e.g., integrated browser)
labels.chat-terminal: The run in terminal tool in chat
labels.chat-terminal-output-monitor: Output monitoring in the terminal tool which detects when commands finish or user input is required
labels.css-less-scss: Issues and items concerning CSS,Less,SCSS styling
labels.debug: Debug viewlet, configurations, breakpoints, adapter issues
labels.dialogs: Issues with native and custom dialogs
labels.dropdown: DropDown (SelectBox widget) native and custom issues
labels.editor-api: Issues about the API of vscode in the area of editors
labels.editor-autoclosing: Editor automatic closing of parens / brackets / etc.
labels.editor-indent-detection: Issues around the guessing of indentation for files
labels.editor-input-IME: Editor input of characters not on keyboard
labels.editor-parameter-hints: Function, method and class parameter hint widget
labels.editor-sorting: Issues related to editor sorting functionality.
labels.editor-synced-region: Issues related to synced region functionality in editor
labels.editor-theming: Issues related to the way themes are applied to editors
labels.emmet-parse: Issue caused by the current Emmet parser
labels.ghost-text: Issues related to ghost text (used for inline-completions and suggestion preview)
labels.install-update: VS Code installation and upgrade system issues
labels.layout: General VS Code workbench layout issues
labels.live-preview: Issues for the Live Preview extension. Please file these under the vscode-livepreview repo instead.
labels.notebook-cell-editor: Bugs related to code editors in Notebooks (not intellisense / LS's)
labels.notebook-execution: Issues related to running cells in a notebook
labels.notebook-language: Bugs related to general interaction with languages
labels.notebook-workflow: Issues that interrupt expected or desirable behavior
labels.open-editors: Issues related to the OPEN EDITORS view
labels.sandbox: Running VSCode in a node-free environment
labels.settings-search: Settings editor remote search provider issues
labels.snap: Issues related to the snap package
labels.terminal: General terminal issues that don't fall under another label
labels.terminal-accessibility: Issues related to the terminal help widget, accessibility buffer, or navigation mode
labels.terminal-conpty: Integrated terminal issues related to the ConPTY backend
labels.terminal-env-collection: Issues related to the EnvironmentVariableCollection API
labels.terminal-inline-chat: Issues related to the terminal inline chat widget
labels.terminal-input: Relating to typing in the terminal not doing the right thing, IMEs not working, etc.
labels.terminal-layout: Issue relating to resizing, scroll bar position, terminal dimensions, etc.
labels.terminal-local-echo: Relating to the terminal's local echo and line editing for remote windows
labels.terminal-parser: Related to xterm.js parsing incoming data from the pty
labels.terminal-persistence: Relating to process reconnection or process revive
labels.terminal-process: Problems launching processes, managing ptys, exiting, process leaks, etc.
labels.terminal-shell-bash: An issue in the terminal specific to bash, including shell integration
labels.terminal-shell-cmd: An issue in the terminal specific to command prompt on Windows
labels.terminal-shell-fish: An issue in the terminal specific to fish, including shell integration
labels.terminal-shell-git-bash: An issue in the terminal specific to git bash on Windows, including shell integration
labels.terminal-shell-integration: Shell integration infrastructure, command decorations, etc.
labels.terminal-shell-pwsh: An issue in the terminal specific to PowerShell, including shell integration
labels.terminal-shell-sh: An issue in the terminal specific to sh (bourne shell), including shell integration
labels.terminal-shell-zsh: An issue in the terminal specific to zsh, including shell integration
labels.timeline-git: Timeline view issues with Git history
labels.titlebar: VS Code main title bar issues
labels.touch/pointer: Touch and Pointer Device support related issues
labels.web: Issues related to running VSCode in the web
labels.webview-views: Webview views in the sidebar and panel
labels.workbench-auxwindow: Issues related to use of auxiliary ("floating") windows.
labels.workbench-diagnostics: General VS Code built-in diagnostic issues
labels.workbench-editor-grid: Grid layout issues in the editor area
labels.workbench-editors: Managing of editor widgets in workbench window
labels.workbench-hot-exit: Preservation of unsaved changes across restarts
labels.workbench-untitled-editors: Managing of untitled editors in workbench window
